name: Halberdier Sergeants
headerMeta: Heroic era · Pike/Polearm infantry · anti-cav · 230 leadership
pitch: A Heroic-era anti-cavalry pike line, functionally the same brace-and-hold unit as Halberdiers but tankier and easier to form up. No dedicated build guide exists on disk, so doctrine, matchup, and control-loop specifics are unproven — treat it as Halberdiers' sturdier sibling until documented.

battleRole.positioning: Performs somewhat better solo than Halberdiers thanks to higher base tankiness, though no source gives specific spacing or pairing guidance. {1}
battleRole.formation: Forms up in F1 more easily than Halberdiers — circle the models up, orient to F1, then brace. {1}
battleRole.tips: Skip the stun doctrine that Halberdiers need — Sergeants get the stun bonus directly from veterancy instead. {1}

videos.label: SuperKitowiec - Halberdiers guide, also covers Sergeants

gaps: No dedicated Amya guide exists for Halberdier Sergeants — only 'Halberdiers' has a thread, a distinct unit (Melee Infantry Honor Tree, T3 Mastery); not conflated here.
No tier-list row and no fight-ratings entry exist for this unit anywhere - meta tier, rarity, and fight ratings (Blob/Flank/Skirmish/Duelling) are all unrecorded.
No doctrines, veterancy build, matchups, or control-loop content exists anywhere for this unit.
All Battle Role content is inferred from a single aside inside a different unit's (Halberdiers) guide video, comparing the two — not a dedicated Sergeants breakdown.
A dedicated 'Halberdier Sergeants Guide (Brace Gods)' video is known to exist (indigenousponchogames channel) but isn't available here - it would likely fill most of these gaps if we get hold of it.

One house Discord recon note places Halberdier Sergeants in Tier 4 as of Season 21 (2024-10-24) {2} — dated meta-tier-list context only, not build guidance, and superseded by two later meta-tier snapshots in the same source that omit this unit entirely.
Confirmed NOT on the 13-unit [Chaos: A Realm Divided] (2026-06-25) balance-change list.
